anchor_initialization.note: The 63 initial_state anchors are admitted and audited, but no code path consumes them: build_material_initial_conditions(spec, rng) still draws the initial state from the scenario recipe plus RNG. The 1957 reconstruction gate is therefore admission-only until the anchors are wired into initialization; the F2 initial state remains synthetic.

data_manifest_notes: Frozen outputs are versioned: v1 stays on disk as the immutable record of the first freeze, v2 supersedes it after the training window was aligned to 1960Q1-1969Q4 and the identification block was declared. A changed control/ontology/registry must produce a new version.

domains.windows: 1957Q1-1985Q4 quarterly simulation with annual targets compared on annual aggregates only; census stocks compared on their real dates only

exposure.note: wage/active-population numerics were read in this study before the freeze; the series is a non-blind frozen-parameter holdout, not a blind one
terminal 1985 industrial values are disclosed in the registry notes; physical preservation of raw files is not evidence of non-exposure
P00-P04 reports contain spot checks of core historical series
unrecorded exposure cannot be undone by deleting or renaming data

identification_notes: Declared identification identity (P05 §D audit), separate from run disposition: every parameter keeps a fixed value at runtime, but only the five 'fixed' entries may be called structurally determined. The new P05 input-credit earmark is a declared mechanism-design rule, not a coefficient estimated from targets. The six P04 behavioural blocks are UNIDENTIFIED: no declared observable constrains them, so they stay prior-constrained and must never be reported as estimated. Basis: P04 prior files declare calibration_status=not_calibrated and engineering values; broker is a pure engineering fixture, while coalition/culture/information/observation/opposition are behavioural objects whose independent observables are not yet obtained. identifiable_set=[], linkage=[], inference_status=NOT_RUN.
linkage_notes: Parameter-to-target linkage (P05 §D): each entry maps a declared latent parameter artifact to the target variable_ids that inform it. Empty means no parameter declares an informing target yet, so the identifiability screen must report NO_IDENTIFIABLE_PARAMETERS rather than invent a candidate set.
